Danny Barker Interviewed by Milt Hinton, April '80 (Tape 1):

I'm sitting here in New Orleans, Louisiana, in the Hyatt-Regency Hotel, talking to my dear friend, longtime companion and musician, Danny Barker -- Daniel Moses Barker, as we call him. And if you hear an unusual noise on this, because outside of the hotel... What do you call what they're doing out there, Danny?

They're piledriving, and they're keeping it up and up and up and up. So it stopped for a minute to get us started, but if it's in there, you'll understand what we're about. Now, Danny, what is that Social Security Number? Do you remember your Social Security number?
And your New York Union Card number? Do you remember that? B...?
